This week's posts 2026-W39

The call is the ritual, not what gets said on it. A week about the short calls, the missed ones, and letting a normal day be enough without needing to ask about it every time.

MonX

Image: pending

The call still goes short: hi, how are you, good, you? Fine. Okay, talk soon. For years I thought that meant we weren't saying the real things. Now I think the real thing was that the call happened at all.
